run_convert_comments: run the script to convert double-slash comments to block comment style in a source file
run_convert_multiple_files: run the script on multiple source files at once to convert all comments in place
review_comment_regex: review the comment regex pattern used to match double-slash comment lines in source files
review_format_as_block: review the format_as_block function that transforms comment lines into C-style block comments
refactor_comment_conversion: refactor the script to support additional comment styles beyond double-slash to block conversion
